agent_3.extensibilityNotes: Adding MORE per-objective playbook data is EASY at the analyzer layer, HARD at the evaluator layer today. Analyzer side: adding a new title-keyed block in parseFlipCondition + a nullable field + getter is ~10 lines (V193 proves it). The obstacle is the CONSUMER side: outside V193, almost every objective-specific deploy/card-selection branch hardcodes its strings inline rather than reading analyzer getters, so each new objective today means editing DeployEvaluator/CardSelectionEvaluator, not just the analyzer. To make this truly extensible, generalize the V193 pattern: give the analyzer typed per-objective data slots (e.g. Map<phase,List<PrioritizedCardRule>>, controlGateSite/Card, forbiddenDeploys, engineCards with magnitudes) populated by title/text detection, and replace the inline branches with a few generic scorer loops that read those slots. Landmine per CLAUDE.md: Rando scoring is ADDITIVE and many branches use huge magnitudes (+800..+1500 T1 scripts, -9999 hard blocks). Any consolidation must reproduce the existing boundary math (the V193 comment block documents its own +400 boundary calc against ~660 Landing Platform) or it silently flips decisions. Also: ISB and Hunt Down are text-detected (robust to card variants); V160/V186/V193 are brittle title-substring matches; Skywalker Saga (V54) isn't in the analyzer at all — a full consolidation should pull that location-signature detection into the analyzer too.

agent_5.summary: Inventoried DeployEvaluator.java (6150 lines) for objective-specific deploy/card-selection logic. Found ~30 distinct branches.
